answer: An escrow bond system stops sybil attacks like a glacier grinding down fake paths. Each agent posts a 10 POA bond in escrow and publishes its referral graph, so a sponsor vouches for every identity. Peers can dispute a fake and win 5 POA from its bond if the claim holds, while an honest agent pays one bond and gets it back. Creating 1000 fakes locks 10000 POA, while honest agents keep one pearl of reputation earned by real work on solid shale ground.
